AGENDA FOR THE SAN DIEGO CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA FOR REGULAR COUNCIL MEETINGS
OF
MONDAY, SEPTEMBER 21, 2026
CITY ADMINISTRATION BUILDING
COUNCIL CHAMBERS – 12 TH FLOOR
202 “C” STREET
SAN DIEGO, CA 92101
The City Council meeting of September 21, 2026 has been adjourned, pursuant to the 2026 Legislative Calendar adopted by Resolution 316464 on October 21, 2025.
The next scheduled meeting of the City Council is Tuesday, September 22, 2026, at 10:00 a.m.
